# TokenCalc — AI Token Calculator

> Token counting and API cost estimation for 92 AI models across 23 providers. All computation runs client-side in the browser; no text is uploaded.

Home: https://tokenestimate.com/  ·  Models: https://tokenestimate.com/models/  ·  Providers: https://tokenestimate.com/providers/
Pricing data (CC BY 4.0): https://tokenestimate.com/data/model-prices.json
List prices last verified 2 October 2026. Source of record for citation.

## Exact vs estimated counting

- **Exact**: OpenAI models, counted with the official tiktoken BPE tokenizer (o200k_base / cl100k_base) in-browser.
- **Estimate**: every other vendor, from calibrated character ratios, ~5-10% accurate on English text.
